tw: Kron has to make an admission to the admiral: the missing mission map is his kite.
twc: Kron 只好向海军上将招认：失踪的任务地图被他做成了风筝。

tw: To give a definition of chef, Kron lifts a lid to show a tiny chef.
twc: 为了给“厨师”下定义，Kron 揭开盖子，里面是个小厨师。

tw: Kron stops to make an introduction: "Duck, meet Truck." The truck honks at the duck.
twc: Kron 停下来介绍：“鸭子，这是卡车。”卡车冲鸭子按喇叭。

tw: Kron waves to make a suggestion, and the bug in his mug nods yes.
twc: Kron 比划着提建议，杯子里的虫子点头同意。
hint: 唯一赞成的是杯里的虫。

tw: Kron runs to give praise to a grey goat that eats its way out of the maze.
twc: Kron 表扬了一只灰山羊，它一路吃出了迷宫。

tw: Kron dares to make a criticism of the critter's kitchen: biscuits in the sink.
twc: Kron 批评小动物的厨房：水槽里的饼干太多了。
hint: 批评的是饼干放错地方。

w: look like two peas in a pod
tw: Kron and Rod the cod look like two peas in a pod in pea hats.
twc: Kron 和鳕鱼罗德戴着豌豆帽，就像豆荚里的两颗豆。

w: get on like a house on fire
tw: Kron and a mouse get on like a house on fire, singing in a choir.
twc: Kron 和一只老鼠一见如故，一起在合唱团里唱歌。

say: have a shoulder to cry on
tw: A sad owl needs to have a shoulder to cry on, so Kron brings a boulder.
twc: 伤心的猫头鹰需要一个肩膀哭，Kron 搬来了一块大石头。

tw: Kron and the hen bury the hatchet in the berry patch, and an egg hatches.
twc: Kron 和母鸡在莓子地里埋下斧头和好，一颗蛋孵出来了。

tw: Kron and his sock know each other inside out, so the sock wears itself inside out.
twc: Kron 和他的袜子彼此了如指掌，袜子干脆把自己翻了过来。
hint: 太了解了，连里子都翻出来。

tw: To be joined at the hip, Kron and a hippo tie a skipping rope round their hips.
twc: 为了形影不离，Kron 和河马用跳绳把腰拴在一起。
hint: 拴在一起，河马一走他就飞。

tw: To clear the air, Kron shares his pear with the bear on the stairs.
twc: 为了消除隔阂，Kron 在楼梯上把梨分给熊吃。

tw: Kron and a seal fall out over a ball, then both fall out of the boat.
twc: Kron 和海豹为一个球吵翻，结果俩都掉出了船。

tw: Kron hangs on the fence by his suspenders: the suspense! One button pops.
twc: Kron 被背带挂在篱笆上：好悬！一颗扣子崩开了。

tw: Kron gives the bossy cat a glossy coat of gloss, and the cat glows.
twc: Kron 给霸道的猫刷了一层亮油，猫闪闪发光。

tw: Kron is dying to try the pie, so he ties two spoons to his toes.
twc: Kron 太想尝那块派了，把两把勺子绑在脚趾上。

tw: To soothe the moose, Kron plays a smooth tune on a shoe.
twc: 为了安抚驼鹿，Kron 用鞋吹了一首柔和的曲子。

tw: Cunning Kron dangles a bun on a string, and his dog keeps running home.
twc: 狡猾的 Kron 用线吊着一个小面包，他的狗一路跑回家。

tw: Kron keeps his apple stall in apple-pie order, till a pig orders a pie.
twc: Kron 把苹果摊摆得井然有序，直到一头猪要买派。
hint: 整整齐齐，被猪一单打乱。
